verdict.rationale: Grafana's tooling can manage multiple environments and supports local development and CI/CD (grafana-docs-26). Observability-as-code enables automated testing before deployment (grafana-docs-3), and Loki/Mimir can run locally in single-binary mode for experimentation (grafana-docs-29, grafana-docs-54), so users can assemble a non-production test setup; however, there is no evidence of a dedicated sandbox environment or seeded test data for agents. Missing for 10: a first-party sandbox/test instance or mode, documented isolation of agent (MCP) actions from production data, mock or seeded test datasets, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
